overview_description.description: jalebi.io is a UAE-based foodtech company that provides an AI-enabled restaurant operating system designed for cafes, restaurants, and multi-branch food businesses. The platform combines inventory management, point-of-sale (POS), supplier CRM, menu management, analytics, reporting, and operational workflows into one integrated solution. Built by restaurant operators and technologists, jalebi.io focuses on reducing food waste, improving cost efficiency, streamlining kitchen operations, and increasing profitability for F&B businesses. The company is backed by Techstars and serves food operators across the GCC and other international markets

about_short_description.short_description: Jalebi is a restaurant operating system that helps food businesses manage POS, inventory, orders & analytics from a single cloud platform.

product.name: jalebi Restaurant Operating System
product.description: A cloud-based system integrating inventory management, point of sale, supplier management, and analytics for restaurants and cafes to control costs and operations.

product.name: Inventory Management System
product.description: A system that tracks food and beverage inventory in real time, linking stock levels to sales and menu items to reduce waste and prevent stockouts.

product.name: Point of Sale (POS) System
product.description: An integrated POS system that records sales transactions, manages orders, and links directly to inventory and menu management for restaurants and cafes.

product.name: Supplier and Supply Chain Management
product.description: A module that manages supplier relationships, purchase orders, and supply chain logistics to ensure timely restocking and cost control for food businesses.

product.name: Menu and Recipe Management
product.description: A tool to create, update, and synchronize menu items and recipes with inventory consumption data for accurate cost tracking and menu planning.

product.name: Analytics and Reporting
product.description: Provides detailed reports and data analytics on sales, inventory, costs, and employee performance to support informed decision-making in food businesses.
